comparison.objective: PR-1405 hand-tightens a spin-on oil filter from pre-contact to the specified post-contact angular range without under- or overtightening; the candidate adjusts and locks a robot-gripper stop before functional cycling.
comparison.physical_skill: PR-1405 tests controlled whole-can wrist rotation, regrasping, gasket-contact referencing, and release; the candidate tests simultaneous hex-driver counterholding and thin-jam-nut wrenching against coupled reaction torque.
comparison.success_condition: PR-1405 grades final rotation past gasket contact, peak overtightening, hand-driven motion, thread retention, and release; the candidate grades target opening, locked retention, repeat-cycle return, drift, nut retention, and clearance.
comparison.reason: Both regulate a rotational setting, but PR-1405 does not test preserving an adjustment screw while locking a coupled jam nut or verifying an articulated mechanism afterward; no material rubric detail is missing.
